combo_label: Getting Around × Board Game Night × Shakespeare

entries.clue: Boat on a fixed crossing, taking cars and walkers over the water
Grid of departures pinned up at the bus stop, or the school day cut into periods
Lovestruck Montague heir who weds in secret and dies in a tomb
Venetian general of Moorish birth, undone by a poisoned ear
Spotted rectangle you match end to end, or stand up in a toppling row
The leaflet fetched mid-argument to prove your brother wrong
Stream of vehicles on the ring road, or a shady trade in contraband
Metered ride hailed at the kerb, or what a plane does trundling on the ground
Four-colour race to get all your pieces home before the others do
Cubes you rattle and then blame when the roll goes badly
Remark meant for the audience alone, unheard by others on the boards
